code: return_trace (c->check_struct (this) && data.sanitize (c, this, dataLen) && map.sanitize (c, this, &(this+data)));
note: The vulnerable revision omitted this range check, so resource offsets were sanitized against the whole blob rather than the declared data block.
After the missing data block validation, the resource map is still accepted and its resource records are followed.
The input-controlled resource offset is checked relative to data_base without the header dataLen bound in the vulnerable revision.
A resource offset outside the declared data area can be cast as an OpenType face, causing byte reads from unintended/out-of-bounds resource data during face sanitization.
